clue.text: Opinion revealed in general survey

definitions.meaning: a personal ... is an opinion held on a matter
a ... can be an overall survey or overview of a subject

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: one's take on something, and a broad look over a scene or topic.

clue.text: Token vicar turned over, stifling pained cry

indicators.note: stifling means smothering, so one piece is held inside the other
turned over tells us the vicar's abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: Rev, short for Reverend, is the title of a vicar
ouch is what you cry when hurt

explanation.surface: A clergyman is upended while someone muffles a yelp of pain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Token' reads as an adjective in the surface, but it is the definition; 'turned over' and 'stifling' both act on the vicar's title.
explanation.definitionFit: A voucher is a token exchangeable for goods or services.

clue.text: Sally's boyfriends invested in film gear

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, like money put into something

parts.note: ET is Spielberg's film about an extraterrestrial
a sally is a witty remark, a quip
boyfriends are men

explanation.surface: A woman's suitors put money into a movie's equipment.
explanation.walkthrough: Sally looks like a woman's name, but a sally is a witty retort; 'invested in' wraps the film round the other two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Gear is a general word for the tools and kit needed for an activity.

clue.text: Beam, seeing talented opponent brought in

indicators.note: brought in signals one piece being taken inside another

parts.note: talented means clever
anti means a person opposed to something

explanation.surface: Someone sees a gifted rival being recruited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seeing' is only a link; 'brought in' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: A cantilever is a beam fixed at one end only, projecting out to carry a load.

clue.text: Fifth Avenue is one, nevertheless

parts.note: one means a, the indefinite article
Fifth Avenue is a New York (NY) way, a street in Manhattan

explanation.surface: A remark that the famous Manhattan street is one, all the same.
explanation.walkthrough: Fifth Avenue is 'a NY way': a street in New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Anyway and nevertheless are both adverbs meaning in spite of that.

clue.text: Aiming to secure practical instruction

definitions.meaning: ... a gun on a target means pointing it, so this sense is pointing at something
teaching of skills by drill and practice, as in job coaching

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to obtain hands-on teaching.
explanation.walkthrough: Two senses of one word, with 'to secure' joining them in the surface: to train a weapon is to aim it.
explanation.definitionFit: Pointing a weapon is called training it, and coaching in skills is also called by the same word.

clue.text: Having no care, pale man entering hospital in good time

parts.note: pale means light, as in a pale colour
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

indicators.note: entering means going inside, so one piece sits within the others

parts.note: in good time means early
Ted is a man's name

explanation.surface: A pallid fellow checks into hospital punctually.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' puts the man inside hospital plus the word for in good time.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting lightheartedly means doing so cheerfully and without worry, as one having no care would.

clue.text: Sign right in centre of Spanish port

indicators.note: in centre of places one piece in the middle of another

parts.note: Vigo is a port in Galicia, north-west Spain

explanation.surface: A signpost points right in the middle of a Spanish harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: Virgo is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac.

clue.text: High temperature of European in cardinal's headgear

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other here

parts.note: a cardinal wears a red hat as a sign of office

explanation.surface: A European wears a cardinal's scarlet hat.
explanation.definitionFit: Red heat is the temperature at which metal glows red, a very high one.

clue.text: Start to behave responsibly when playing?

definitions.text: Start to behave responsibly when playing?

parts.words: Start to behave responsibly when playing?
parts.note: an idiom for reforming one's conduct, read literally as tidying up a stage performance

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to begin behaving better, and the question mark invites a literal theatrical reading.

clue.text: Posh girl university accepted as a rule

parts.note: U means upper-class, the posh usage

indicators.note: accepted means taken in, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: Sally is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A well-to-do young woman gets into university as expected.
explanation.walkthrough: U meaning upper-class comes from Nancy Mitford's 'U and non-U' speech. 'accepted' puts U inside SALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: Usually and as a rule both mean normally, in most cases.

clue.text: In high dudgeon, being endlessly at risk

indicators.note: endlessly read as end-less: the word for risk loses its letters spelling end

parts.note: at risk means endangered

explanation.surface: Someone is furious at being in perpetual danger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' is read as 'without END': ENDANGERED minus END.
explanation.definitionFit: High dudgeon is a state of deep resentment, so someone in it is angry.

clue.text: Novelist opposed to comedian? Cling to mere possibility

parts.note: Anthony Hope wrote The Prisoner of Zenda
opposed to means against
Bob Hope was a famous comedian

explanation.surface: A writer is set up against a comic.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to keep hoping when there is very little chance.

clue.text: In Qatar he sustained an Asian macaque

indicators.note: In tells us the answer sits within the following words

explanation.surface: A Gulf state supported a monkey from Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhesus is a macaque monkey of South and East Asia, used widely in research.

clue.text: Diversion that may be simple

definitions.meaning: a pastime or hobby that holds one's attention
money charged on a loan, which may be simple or compound

explanation.definitionFit: A hobby is an interest, and charges on a loan are interest, simple or compound.

clue.text: A girl then represented as a sci-fi character

indicators.note: represented means presented again in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A young woman is depicted as a figure in science fiction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'represented' signals the anagram of A GIRL THEN.
explanation.definitionFit: In science fiction, aliens call a human from Earth by this name.

clue.text: Pass work in note for writer

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the note

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
to pass, as time does, is to roll (the years roll by)
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: A message tells someone to hand over a piece of work to an author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container; Anthony Trollope was a Victorian novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Trollope was an English writer of novels such as Barchester Towers.

clue.text: Last lines in maritime contract?

parts.note: bottom means last, as in bottom of the class
RY, railway, means lines

explanation.surface: Final clauses in a shipping agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: Bottomry is a historical contract in which a ship's owner pledged the vessel as security for a loan.

clue.text: A poet's connections

definitions.meaning: Robert ..., the Poet Laureate, is a poet; 's stands for is
spans or links joining two things

explanation.definitionFit: Robert Bridges was Poet Laureate, and spans linking two sides are also the same word.

clue.text: Description of member from cold country

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps
country used as an adjective means rural

explanation.surface: An account of an MP from a chilly land.
explanation.definitionFit: Crural is the anatomical adjective for the leg, a limb or member.

clue.text: Dog with feathered decoy runs round church

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the first pieces go round the other

parts.note: a lure is a bunch of feathers used by falconers to recall a hawk
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A dog with a decoy bird races around a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link; 'round' signals the container. A falconer's lure is a bundle of feathers.
explanation.definitionFit: A lurcher is a crossbred dog, typically greyhound with collie or terrier.

clue.text: Drat relative, dispatching first rook!

indicators.note: dispatching means sending away, so letters are removed

parts.note: a brother is a relative

indicators.note: first means just the initial letter of rook is taken

explanation.surface: A cry of annoyance at a family member who has just taken a chess piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are mild exclamations of annoyance.

clue.text: Where Cockneys assemble as a group, say, wearing nothing?

indicators.note: Cockneys famously drop their aitches, so an H is lost

parts.note: where people assemble: in the hall
to assemble as a group is to gather together

explanation.surface: East Londoners gather as a crowd, perhaps in the nude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cockneys' drops the H of HALL: London Cockney speech drops initial H. 'say' signals the sense is read from the phrase as spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means naked, being clothed in nothing at all.

clue.text: Discover whereabouts of strap for drawing carriage

definitions.meaning: to find or track down something
one of the two side straps by which a horse pulls a cart

explanation.definitionFit: To find someone is to track them down, and the harness strap of a carriage horse has the same name.

clue.text: Hoofed mammal droppings seen around a cape

indicators.note: around means the first piece encloses the rest

parts.note: guano is the droppings of seabirds or bats
C is the abbreviation for cape on maps

explanation.surface: An animal's dung is found near a headland.
explanation.definitionFit: The guanaco is a wild South American relative of the llama, a hoofed animal.

clue.text: Diabolical explosive damaged hills

parts.note: HE is the abbreviation for high explosive

indicators.note: damaged means broken up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bomb wrecks the hillsides.
explanation.definitionFit: Hellish and diabolical both mean devilish, fit for hell.

clue.text: One loved the sherbet centre, for example

parts.note: sherbet is an example of a sweet, a fizzy confection
the heart is the centre of something

explanation.surface: A treat's middle filling is someone's favourite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for example' marks sherbet as an instance of a sweet; 'the' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweetheart is a person someone is in love with.

clue.text: Gelatinous substance obtained from a fish

parts.note: the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: Jelly taken from a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Agar is a jelly-like substance from seaweed, used in cooking and laboratories.
